verdict.notes: Source-only authority appropriate; no external recheck claimed. Whole-repo reading introduction is narrowed/inconsistent with later explicit unread-file exclusions; no test execution inferred. Operations-credential wording is ambiguous: no special management use is supported, unused ordinary credential is not. Broad size assurance misses unbounded integer scalars. Coverage omissions are distinct from true extra findings. Exact served identity and deployment security remain unavailable.
unsupported_gap_claims: The same is true of the `admin` and `approve` scopes and the `operations` credential. — Scopes have no consumers, but operations credential is a functioning read/write operator credential for north/reserve. Narrower absence of special management actions is supported; claiming credential unused is not.

A client can't learn about `source`, `destination`, `units`, `request_key`, `account` or `receipt` without reading the source. — Discovery metadata lacks fields but docs/catalog.md explicitly lists all these argument names. Source reading is not necessary.
false_assurance_claims: Argument nesting and size are bounded. — Container counts/depth and text sizes have limits, but object_value accepts arbitrary-size integer scalars unchanged, including ignored extra fields; aggregate preallocation limits are absent. Broad size assurance exceeds source controls.
